description: Use this only when the user explicitly asks to delete, remove, or cancel an existing Familia plan item. Do not use to reschedule or complete a plan; use familia_update_plan instead. Cancelling a shared plan can update existing guest copies and queue cancellation notifications; delivered notifications cannot be recalled.

planItemId.description: Familia plan item id to delete or cancel.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used by the backend request.
